caseName: Darrigo v. State Commission on Judicial Conduct
caseNameFull: Darrigo v. State Commission on Judicial Conduct

opinions.text:
Appeal from App. Div., Sup. Ct. N. Y., 1st Jud. Dept., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.

Justice White and Justice Stevens would dismiss for want of substantial federal question.
